title: Low-Cost Solar Water Disinfection DIY Poster
title_te: సూర్యరశ్మితో నీటి శుద్ధి – తక్కువ ఖర్చు పోస్టర్
problem: Poor families who cannot afford water purifiers get sick from drinking untreated well water during summer power cuts.
idea: A simple guide to SODIS – cleaning water with sunlight in clear plastic bottles. Follow the steps, then check if your bottle is ready.

items.title: Pick the bottle
items.text: Use a clean, clear PET plastic bottle (1 or 2 litres). No coloured or scratched bottles.

items.title: Check the water
items.text: Water must be clear. If it is very muddy, let it settle and filter it through cloth first.
items.te: నీరు స్పష్టంగా ఉండాలి. బురదగా ఉంటే ముందు బట్టతో వడకట్టండి.

items.title: Fill and close
items.text: Fill the bottle full and close the cap tightly.
items.te: బాటిల్ నిండా నింపి మూత గట్టిగా పెట్టండి.

items.title: Keep in the sun
items.text: Lay it flat on a roof or tin sheet in full sun for at least 6 hours.

items.title: Cloudy day?
items.text: If the sky is cloudy, keep it in the sun for 2 full days.

widgets.heading: ✅ Is my SODIS bottle ready to drink?

items.text: Bottle is clear PET plastic, not coloured
Kept in full sun for 6 hours (2 days if cloudy)
Cap was closed the whole time
Drinking straight from the bottle or a clean glass
items.te: బాటిల్ నుండి లేదా శుభ్రమైన గ్లాసులో తాగుతున్నాం

bands.text: Ready! Your water is safer to drink. 👍
Not ready yet. Every box must be ticked before drinking.

questions.q: How long should the bottle stay in full sun?
questions.why: Sunlight needs at least 6 hours to kill most germs.
Sunlight must pass through the bottle, so it must be clear.

questions.q: Can SODIS clean very muddy water?
options: No, filter and settle it first
questions.why: Mud blocks the sunlight, so the germs survive.

how: Ask Gemini to explain the SODIS method in 5 simple steps.
Check the steps with your science teacher.
Open Canva and choose a Poster template.
Add one picture and one short line for each step, in English and Telugu.
Print the poster and stick it near the village well or Anganwadi.
Show one family how to do it with a real bottle.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Explain the SODIS solar water disinfection method in 5 short steps for village families, in simple English and Telugu. Mention clear PET bottles, 6 hours of full sun, 2 days if cloudy, and that very muddy water must be filtered first.
